skills.name: World Through a Shutter
skills.description: Goes through window portals to  attack enemies from behind.  Bad effects on enemies.  *Enemy Evade Rate -30% (10 sec) *Enemy ATK -30% (10 sec) *ATK x 4000% Area Damage

skills.name: Snapping Memories
skills.description: Holds up his smartphone, and his  friends appear to take a photo.  Good effects on allies.  *Hit Rate +40% (8 sec) *ATK Speed +180% (8 sec) *Move Speed +180% (8 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Dead Account
abilities.description: Dead Account Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and HP buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Ally Clone
abilities.description: Has a set chance of summoning 1 allied team Ranger when Rangers deploy.　  - Flyer and Air Ambush Rangers are not eligible to be summoned in this way.  - The Abilities of allied Rangers summoned by this Ability won't activate. - Summoned Rangers won't consume any Mineral and will have no effects on redeploy times.
